name: Srestha Finvest Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1985, Srestha Finvest Ltd 
provides Loans, Finance, and Investments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is registered as a Category B Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking NBFC - Investment and Credit Company which lends money against Securities, Movable and immovable properties, Finance, Hire purchase and Leasing, and also does trading and  investing in shares

pros: Stock is trading at 0.30 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -13.2% over last 3 years.
